# AGT-ACT-01

**Is every action the agent can take in the world listed, with its effect and whether it can be undone?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | ACT: Actions and blast radius |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.agent.tools` |

## Why it matters

An action not listed has no guardrail.

## Rule

Every agent facet has at least one tool, and every tool has effect, reversible, tier and approval (the schema enforces the fields). A reviewer checks the list is complete against the connectors the agent can call.
